protocol.policy: Union pretrained SAM3 surface masks at confidence>=0.3; nearest-neighbor resize, convex hull. Reject candidate outside hull plus specified margin. If surface area<5% or>95%, leave candidates unchanged. Use frozen full1920 YOLO candidates and three verifiers, with the original threshold and score product.
protocol.scope: Post-audit exploratory follow-up on already opened150frames. Filter can reject real airborne or held balls. No manual rink polygon or new model training; no default replay change.
